branch.title: Move “{{title}}”
branch.moveHint: The branch leaves its tree and then stands only in the target (below the root).
branch.transferHint: The same branch then stands in both trees; nothing is copied.

sharedDelete.title: Delete “{{title}}” everywhere?
sharedDelete.message: The node stands in several trees ({{trees}}) and disappears from all of them. Sub-nodes that stand only here go to the trash too. “Remove here” takes it out of the current tree only.

removed.title: Formerly in …
removed.parentGone: The old parent no longer stands there; the branch goes under the root.
removed.restoredAtRoot: The old parent was missing: “{{title}}” now stands under the root of {{name}}.
